decision: Bai kiem cua E6 bo ban gia AgentTriggerService, dung dich vu THAT, va gui HAI ma khong khop trong cung mot lo; onboardingMatchNeeded truyen subject platformBrokerId va dat required=true
impact: Loi soi so 1 trong hop dong nam o dedupe cua enqueue, ma ban gia thay han dich vu do nen chay chinh lenh E6 thi loi vo hinh — khong co chieu do. Chu kho duyet cham vao dat nay ngay 20/09 (hoi truc tiep trong phien), doi lai: muc NGOAI hop dong 'Hinh dang 2 — E6 ve 3' (de xuat known-limits) co the bien mat khoi danh sach vong soi lan 2, nen mat co hoi tu quyet. Chieu do da chay va DO dung cho: ca hai ma la deu mat vi mot viec onboarding-identify con treo tu bai kiem truoc khop bat ky. Chong trung nay khoa theo MA, khong theo cap ma+ke hoach: mot viec nhan dien cho moi ma la du, vi tac nhan ghi ma len Ca nhan roi lo sau tu khop. required=true doi mot loi ghi that thanh 500 de nen tang gui lai ca lo (upsert ghi danh va enqueue deu chiu chay lai), thay vi nuot loi roi van dem vao so da chuyen
